one_liner: APA-endorsed professional liability insurance exclusively for psychologists with 50+ years of specialized coverage.

long_description: The Trust Risk Management Services, commonly known as the APA Insurance Trust, has been the American Psychological Association's endorsed professional liability insurance program for over 50 years. The Trust provides coverage exclusively to psychologists, including licensed psychologists, psychology doctoral students, and psychology interns. Their policies are specifically designed to address the unique liability exposures psychologists face, including coverage for psychological testing, forensic work, custody evaluations, and telehealth services. The Trust offers occurrence-based policies with limits up to $3M/$3M through their carrier, ACE American Insurance Company. APA members receive preferred rates. The Trust is renowned for their risk management resources specifically tailored to psychology practice, including free ethics consultations, CE courses on liability issues, sample consent forms, and documentation guides. Their Advocate 800 program provides 24/7 access to risk management consultation.
best_for: Psychologists doing forensic or custody work
not_for: Those seeking lowest premium (focus is comprehensive coverage)

pricing.notes: APA members receive preferred rates. Premiums vary by state, coverage limits, practice focus (forensic work costs more), and hours worked. Online quotes available.

compliance.notes: APA-endorsed program. Policies underwritten by ACE American Insurance Company (Chubb). Over 50 years serving psychologists.
